model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the training loss over iterations for several variants of the SepLLM model, alongside a “Vanilla” baseline. The x-axis, labeled “#Iteration,” spans from 0 to 140,000 with major tick marks at intervals of 20,000, and uses a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled “Loss,” ranges from 2.4 to 3.4 with tick marks at intervals of 0.1, also on a linear scale. Six distinct lines are plotted: “Vanilla” (purple, solid line) begins near 3.35 and declines steadily to approximately 2.50; “StrmLLM (n=64)” (blue, solid line) starts near 3.35 and decreases to about 2.62; “SepLLM (n=64)” (orange, solid line) begins around 3.30 and settles near 2.54; “SepLLM (n=64, H)” (green, solid line) starts near 3.28 and ends around 2.53; “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” (red, solid line) begins at approximately 3.27 and converges near 2.52; and “SepLLM (n=128)” (dark blue, solid line) starts near 3.35 and drops to roughly 2.60. All lines exhibit a steep initial decline in loss followed by a gradual flattening, indicating convergence as iterations increase.
